overlayEntry.notes: FPI is an inflation-index hybrid, not an uncollateralized reflexive dollar. Frax documents a CPI-U target updated through a specialized Chainlink oracle on each monthly BLS release, a 100%-collateral-ratio design, FRAX mint and redemption through the Controller Pool (0.30% fee), and FPIS sales via TWAMM when AMO yield trails the target inflation rate; the overview now also documents the community-approved FPIS phase-out, with FPIS convertible to FRAX at 2.5:1 on 2028-03-22. The reviewed 2026-07-27 collateral API snapshot (updatedAtBlock 25627253, updatedAtTimestampSec 1785192707, fetched 2026-07-27T22:52:02Z) identifies, over the non-FPI collateral base of $1,090,519.52: 87.1% FRAX ($949,391.42 across the Ethereum Comptroller, a second Ethereum wallet balance, and Fraxtal), 12.9% LP positions (staked Convex FPI/FRAX at $124,758.08 and Fraxswap V2 FRAX/FPIS FRAX-portion at $16,370.02), and a de minimis FXS remainder (~$0.005). The profile therefore records 0.871 directly identified exogenous stablecoin backing, 0.000 explicitly reflexive FXS/FPIS exposure (down from 0.076 as the Comptroller FXS balance ran down to dust), and leaves the LP remainder outside either claim instead of pretending it is cash, unchanged in method from the 2026-07-23 review. The API separately lists $6.32M of Comptroller-held FPI against 5,855,654.51 FPI total supply, but per the established profile method the backing shares are computed over the non-FPI collateral only. Collateral coverage, the oracle path, the reflexive backstop, and protocol redemption remain supported; a re-check of docs.frax.com FPI pages on 2026-07-27 found reserve unwind depth, emergency recovery, and a holder loss-recovery waterfall still issuer-undisclosed, so those facts keep their prior dispositions. No grade target is encoded: those unavailable facts remain bounded in their own mechanism components, and the 87.1% FRAX reserve dependency remains separately evaluated.
